title: Jesus prayed in a deserted place
description: Very early in the morning, while it was still dark, Jesus got up and went to a deserted place to pray. Simon and those with him hurried after him, and when they found him, they said that everyone was looking for him. Jesus answered that they should go on to the nearby towns so he could preach there too, for that was why he had come out. So he traveled throughout Galilee, preaching in the synagogues and driving out evil spirits.
